title: Every Eichler integral of a cusp form has constant modular defects
statement: Let N,n∈ℕ with N≠0, let Γ=Γ₀(N), and let ρ be the restriction of binaryFormRepSL ℂ n to Γ. Let f be a cusp form of weight n+2 on the prescribed real matrix image of Γ, and let F : ℍ → BinaryForm ℂ n satisfy IsEichlerIntegral n f F. Then IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith ρ F holds: for every γ∈Γ there is c∈BinaryForm ℂ n such that F(γτ)−ρ(γ)F(τ)=c for every τ∈ℍ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (f : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) ((n : ℤ) + 2)) (F : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n (fun τ => f τ) F → HeckeEis.IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith ((HeckeEis.binaryFormRepSL ℂ n).comp (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N).subtype) F
